import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1 << 20;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        boolean[] mark = new boolean[MAXN];

        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        long product = 1;

        if (k == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
                product = (product * p) % MOD;
            }
            System.out.println(product);
            return;
        }

        long inv = 1;
        while ((inv * k) % p != 1) {
            inv++;
        }

        if (k == 1) {
            product = p;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if (!mark[i]) {
                product = (product * p) % MOD;
                long j = i;
                while (!mark[(int) j]) {
                    mark[(int) j] = true;
                    j = (j * inv) % p;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(product);
        sc.close();
    }
}
